It calls `accrue-user-debts` over the position's debt list, then reads `(get index (unwrap-panic (get-cached-indexes asset-id)))`. Establish what happens when the repaid asset is not in that list - a debt row filtered out by the enabled mask, a repayment on behalf of an account with no such row, an asset accrued under a different id - and whether the `unwrap-panic` aborts or an unrelated index is used to size the repayment. Impact: permanent freezing of an unrepayable debt, or theft of unclaimed yield.'
